title: Theory to what Mall World is...

classification.theory_summary: Author proposes Mall World is triggered by near-death physiological events during sleep (e.g., sleep apnea) and functions as a "loading zone for the dead."
classification.question_topic: Asks for others' thoughts on the proposed near-death/sleep-apnea trigger theory
classification.skip_reason: No describable dream scenes/locations; only a theory prompted by a recent episode during sleep.

meta.author_theory: Mall World dreams may be triggered when the body is in danger during sleep (e.g., stopped breathing/sleep apnea) and could be a "loading zone for the dead."

extraction.extraction_notes: Only non-dream phenomenology described: girlfriend observed the author stop breathing in sleep for nearly a minute, then take small breaths before resuming normal breathing. No in-dream setting details were provided.
